title: break step config
description: Halts the pipeline when a condition on a context field holds; otherwise the step continues to next_step.

output_field.description: Context key whose value is reported as the pipeline's final output when the step halts.

condition.description: Halt condition evaluated over a context field; without it the step never halts.

input_field.description: Flat context key to evaluate; score conditions also read <input_field>.score.

match_value.description: Reference for equals, contains and label_equals; bare YAML booleans are normalised to YES or NO.
